## Why this pass

The latest repository work leaves quantified obligations about actual ordinary histories, canonical harmonic mass, and invariant labels. This pass tries to discharge those obligations using termination theory, directed recurrence and affine renewal, higher-order rigidity, and simultaneous Mahler equations. Each note states the theorem hypotheses, performs the applicable calculations, and identifies the first remaining unsupported step. PR186's literature guide is credited as an input.

## Substantive outcomes

### 1. An all-parameter test of the existing maximal-corridor rank

For every `b >= 3` and `K >= 1`, an explicit simultaneous congruence gives infinitely many positive ordinary starting integers with `K` exact alternating maximal modes `(2,1),(b,1)`. Every displayed repetition count is exactly one.

The pair map is

`H_b(n) = (3^(b+2)n + 13*3^b - 2^(b+3)) / 2^(b+4)`.

Writing `n_j = H_b^j(n_0)` and `y_j = g_2(n_j)`, the pre-existing infinite rank has exact values

`R_*(n_j) = (n_j+5)^2/9`,  
`R_*(y_j) = (y_j+5)^2/81`.

The proof compares every index of the infinite envelope. From the unsafe state `y_0`, the rank stays strictly above its initial value for `2K-1` maximal modules. Consequently a fixed number of mode switches cannot guarantee repayment for this rank.

For each selected pair, the explicit counter `Z_b(n) = (3^(b+2)-2^(b+4))n + 13*3^b - 2^(b+3)` has a dyadic valuation that decreases by `b+4`. The remaining task is to pay for arbitrary changes of the selected word. The statement concerns changing finite ordinary witnesses; it does not construct one positive infinite orbit or refute the stronger joint source-certificate program.

[Written proof and termination-theorem hypotheses](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9d4ae09cd50ccd54036141edc3938d2cabe786fd/research/deep-machinery-20261122/termination/MODE_REFINEMENT_ATTEMPT.md)

### 2. Actual directed recurrence and a genuine implicit-renewal application

Under the pinned harmonic inputs, the symmetrized chain is recurrent. An explicit oscillatory sequence on its actual clock levels violates the strong sector condition needed to transfer that conclusion to the directed chain.

For independent geometric exponents, every applicable Kesten–Goldie hypothesis is checked, and the perpetuity satisfies

`lim t*P(R>t) = 1/log(27/16)`.

Keeping an actual ordinary prefix in the comparison gives `q_k^2 <= C_p*3^k`, weaker than the elementary ordinary-orbit bound. The note also computes the exact likelihood ratio between the independent affine law and the canonical inverse law, so no equality of those laws is assumed. Its additional moving-fibre calculation explicitly retains the recent manuscript as a source-qualified premise.

[Directed recurrence, change of law, and affine renewal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9d4ae09cd50ccd54036141edc3938d2cabe786fd/research/deep-machinery-20261122/boundary/RECURRENCE_AND_AFFINE_BOUNDARY.md)

### 3. Full-law rigidity control and a direct actual-sibling follow-up

The correlation note derives the exact residue-error identities. Even if every error vanished, the resulting averaged law `D2_*mu = (mu + D3_*mu)/2` does not imply separate dilation invariance. An explicit stationary Boolean process with a positive continuous circle density demonstrates this at every order. It is a control for that inference, not an asserted Collatz label.

The direct follow-up attacks OPEN-S/OPEN-F from PR180. Adaptive rank pairing of legal inverse exponents yields a prefix-preserving bijection of retained ordinary inverse trees. Its exact critical-weight ratio is

`w_m/w_n = (m/n)*(z/z')*(Lambda'/Lambda)`.

For `m=B^j(n)`, the true sibling factor `64^(-j)` cancels the leading height factor. The resulting finite stopping-antichain inequality retains the canonical obstacle and the actual ordinary terminal heights. The required averaged reciprocal distortion of order `1/log(2+n)` remains unproved. The crude depth comparison is weaker than the existing obstacle floor and is labeled accordingly.

### 4. Simultaneous Mahler closure

The basin generating function satisfies exact mixed dilation identities and all-prefix binary-to-ternary section identities. The proposed rotation basis generates an unbounded root-of-unity ladder. No fixed finite system, as required by the simultaneous Mahler rationality theorems, is obtained.

The note writes out why rationality would imply convergence, credits the existing Bell–Lagarias criterion, and distinguishes finite arrival approximants from the all-time series. This is not a no-go theorem against every possible Mahler representation.
